summary_1line: Chitrangada and Babhruvahana lament Arjuna’s death until Ulupi prepares to use a serpent gem to revive him, revealing the battle was orchestrated.

image_candidates.scene_text: Chitrangada collapses beside Arjuna’s lifeless body on the battlefield, clutching his feet while warriors stand silently around.
Babhruvahana kneels in despair before his father’s corpse, vowing to starve himself as his grieving mother sits on the ground nearby.
Ulupi stands amid the stunned warriors holding a luminous serpent gem capable of restoring the dead.
